_doc: Kailh Choc v1 (PG1350) low-profile switches: the PCB footprint. Positions from the switch's centre, seen from above, y up (behind the switch is +y). kind as in x1c.json.
name: choc

pitch.rule: Key spacing on a board that also takes MX switches (Choc's own is 18 x 17 mm)
pitch.source: Cherry MX keyboard layout convention: a hybrid MX/Choc board keeps MX spacing

pcb_pin1_x.rule: PCB footprint: pin 1, on the centre line
pcb_pin1_x.source: ergogen's Kailh Choc v1 footprint, https://github.com/ergogen/ergogen/blob/master/src/footprints/choc.js (KiCad frame, y down; turned to y up here), MIT

pcb_pin1_y.rule: PCB footprint: pin 1, behind the centre
pcb_pin1_y.source: ergogen's Kailh Choc v1 footprint, https://github.com/ergogen/ergogen/blob/master/src/footprints/choc.js (KiCad frame, y down; turned to y up here), MIT

pcb_pin2_x.rule: PCB footprint: pin 2, right of the centre
pcb_pin2_x.source: ergogen's Kailh Choc v1 footprint, https://github.com/ergogen/ergogen/blob/master/src/footprints/choc.js (KiCad frame, y down; turned to y up here), MIT

pcb_pin2_y.rule: PCB footprint: pin 2, behind the centre
pcb_pin2_y.source: ergogen's Kailh Choc v1 footprint, https://github.com/ergogen/ergogen/blob/master/src/footprints/choc.js (KiCad frame, y down; turned to y up here), MIT

pcb_pin_drill.rule: PCB footprint: drill for the two electrical pins
pcb_pin_drill.source: ergogen's Kailh Choc v1 footprint, https://github.com/ergogen/ergogen/blob/master/src/footprints/choc.js (KiCad frame, y down; turned to y up here), MIT

pcb_pin_pad.rule: PCB footprint: copper pad round each electrical pin
pcb_pin_pad.source: ergogen's Kailh Choc v1 footprint, https://github.com/ergogen/ergogen/blob/master/src/footprints/choc.js (KiCad frame, y down; turned to y up here), MIT

pcb_centre_hole.rule: PCB footprint: unplated hole for the switch's centre post
pcb_centre_hole.source: ergogen's Kailh Choc v1 footprint, https://github.com/ergogen/ergogen/blob/master/src/footprints/choc.js (KiCad frame, y down; turned to y up here), MIT

pcb_peg_x.rule: PCB footprint: the two locating pegs, either side of the centre
pcb_peg_x.source: ergogen's Kailh Choc v1 footprint, https://github.com/ergogen/ergogen/blob/master/src/footprints/choc.js (KiCad frame, y down; turned to y up here), MIT

pcb_peg_hole.rule: PCB footprint: unplated holes for the locating pegs
pcb_peg_hole.source: ergogen's Kailh Choc v1 footprint, https://github.com/ergogen/ergogen/blob/master/src/footprints/choc.js (KiCad frame, y down; turned to y up here), MIT

pcb_body.rule: The switch's housing seen from above: 15 x 15 mm, nothing taller than a pad under it
pcb_body.source: Kailh PG1350 drawing, as quoted at https://deskthority.net/wiki/Kailh_PG1350_series (15 x 15 x 8 mm)

height_pcb.rule: Switch height above the PCB, without a keycap (with a 1.2 mm plate the housing sits on the plate)
height_pcb.source: Kailh PG1350 drawing, as quoted at https://deskthority.net/wiki/Kailh_PG1350_series

pin_length.rule: Electrical pins below the housing (they reach through a 1.6 mm board by about 1.4 mm before trimming)
pin_length.source: Kailh PG1350 drawing (3.0 mm pins): measure a switch to confirm
